csv_project_name: DB for Electric Vehicle Charging Network
csv_scope_of_work: The Confederated Tribes of Siletz Indians (CTSI) seeks proposals from qualified firms to provide turnkey design-build services for a regional electric vehicle (EV) charging network consisting of up to thirty-two (32) DC Fast Charging ports throughout Lincoln County, Oregon. The final configuration may consist of any combination of single-port and dual-port Level 3 charging stations capable of serving public, tribal government, fleet, transit, and emergency response vehicles. CTSI intends to establish a countywide EV charging network supporting: Tribal government operations Tribal transit vehicles Community charging access Emergency management resilience Economic development Tourism and regional travel Future fleet electrification
csv_disciplines_requested: Design Build/Developer, Electrical Engineering, Energy Engineering
